honeypot.off_summary: Nobody is caught while it has no channel.

checkpoint.copied_description: Share it with a member who was stopped, or pin it in the verification channel.

honeypotChaosName.description: The daily name is random characters instead of a name from WolfStar's list, against the bots that keep a list of channel names. While on, it takes the place of the daily rename.
honeypotChaosName.name: Random Characters as Name

honeypotDirectMessage.description: Tells the member it caught why, in a direct message. A hacked account that is softbanned can come back once its owner has it again.
honeypotDirectMessage.name: Tell Caught Members Why

honeypotEnsureDeletion.description: Two minutes after the action, WolfStar looks for what the member left in the channels and deletes it, since a ban does not always delete everything.
honeypotEnsureDeletion.name: Ensure Deletion

honeypotForwardMessage.description: Forwards what the member sent to the catches channel before WolfStar deletes it, attachments included. Needs a catches channel.
honeypotForwardMessage.name: Forward the Caught Message

honeypotKeepActive.description: WolfStar sends a message there every day, so the channel does not look abandoned.
honeypotKeepActive.name: Keep Honeypot Active

honeypotLogChannel.description: Every member it caught, with what they sent. The case still goes to the moderation logs.
honeypotLogChannel.name: Honeypot Catches Channel

honeypotRandomName.description: The bots cannot avoid the channel by its name.
honeypotRandomName.name: Rename Honeypot Daily

honeypotRecentDelete.description: A softban or a ban deletes what the member sent in the last 15 minutes instead of the last hour, which keeps more of the history of the channels.
honeypotRecentDelete.name: Delete Only Recent Messages

honeypotTimeoutFirst.description: Times the member out for an hour before the softban or the ban, so a hacked account that comes back at once still cannot write. A kick gets no timeout.
honeypotTimeoutFirst.name: Time Out First

honeypotWarning.description: Without it the channel says nothing, which is harder for a bot to learn to avoid, and for a member too.
honeypotWarning.name: Honeypot Warning
